# logcut v0.1.4

This release adds concise Jest failure summaries to `logcut`.

## Changes

* Added a `jest` profile and automatic Jest output detection.
* Included failed test files and failed test names in Jest summaries.
* Included relevant assertion errors and the final Jest test summary.
* Added integration coverage for explicit Jest selection and automatic detection.
* Updated the README, package version, lockfile, and release workflow for v0.1.4.

## Compatibility

The existing command-line interface, profiles, environment variables, logging behavior, signal handling, and exit-code behavior remain unchanged.
